project.ItemDescriptionShort: Shows what a quest's Town Event reward actually does, right on the quest select screen.
project.Title: Expeditions Town Events Hints
project.ItemDescription:
Show hints when a quest results in some Town Event that explains what the event does
[b]Before[/b] Town Event: Silence in the Crypts
[b]After[/b] Town Event: Silence in the Crypts Ruins: +33% Resolve XP, +15% DMG
[b]Affected Expeditions[/b] Activate quests: Silence in the Crypts, Sunshine in the Thicket, Gentle Tide, Fresh Air in the Tunnels. Gather quests: All Saints Day, Caregivers Convention, Lost and Found, Bumper Crop.
[b]Compatibility[/b] Text only. It is a localization override of the eight event title strings - no gameplay, no balance, no stats, and no layout files. Every number is read straight out of the game's own buff definitions rather than copied from a guide.
The lines are written short on purpose so they fit the quest panel without anything being clipped or moved.
Conflicts only with mods that rewrite these same eight strings. Safe to add or remove mid-campaign.
[b]Bugs[/b] Because the title strings are shared, the effect lines also appear in the town event announcement and in the activity log entry for these eight events.
[b]English only[/b] Playing in another language? Use "Expeditions Town Events Hints (International)" instead. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3791806160
[b]Source Code[/b] https://github.com/Vergir/DD-ExpeditionsTownEventsHints Also MIT licensed, so hack away.
[b]AI Usage[/b] AI was heavily used to write code, rephrase words for a better fit and to write docs. AI was not used for icon art.
